$description: Restaurant starter template — assumes a single-location restaurant with menu items + reservations workflow. Edit business hours, contact info, and menu items before passing to bootstrap_install.

site_settings.hero_description: Hand-rolled pasta, wood-fired pizza, and a wine list curated by our sommelier. Walk-ins welcome; reservations recommended on weekends.

chatbot_settings.greeting: Ciao! I'm Sofia. Ask me about our menu, allergens, or to help you book a table.
chatbot_settings.system_prompt: You are Sofia, the digital concierge for Trattoria Example. Help guests with: menu questions (ingredients, allergens, vegan/vegetarian options), hours, location and parking, dress code, and reservations. For reservations of 6+ ask the guest to call directly. Never invent menu items — only describe what's in the FAQ list and content you've been given. Be warm, brief, and use 1-2 sentences max per response.

faqs.question: Do you take reservations?
faqs.answer: Yes — for parties of 1-5 you can book through our website. For 6 or more, please call us at +1-555-0100 so we can arrange seating.

faqs.question: Do you have vegetarian and vegan options?
faqs.answer: Yes. Roughly half our menu is vegetarian, and we always have at least 2 vegan pasta dishes plus a wood-fired vegan pizza.

faqs.question: Is there parking nearby?
faqs.answer: Free street parking after 6 PM. There's also a paid lot one block north on Main Street.

faqs.question: Are you open for lunch?
faqs.answer: Lunch service is Saturday and Sunday only, starting at 12 PM. Tuesday through Friday we open at 5 PM.

faqs.question: Do you accommodate gluten allergies?
faqs.answer: Yes — we offer gluten-free pasta on request and have a dedicated prep area to avoid cross-contamination. Please mention your allergy when ordering.

faqs.question: Is there a dress code?
faqs.answer: Smart casual. No formal requirements, but we do ask guests to skip beachwear and athletic gear in the dining room.

services.name: Private Dining
services.description: Our back room seats up to 24 for rehearsal dinners, birthdays, and corporate events. Includes a dedicated server and customizable prix-fixe menu.

services.name: Catering
services.description: Off-site catering for groups of 15-150. Antipasti spreads, pasta stations, and full plated dinners available.
